designDirection.name: restrained editorial B2B
designDirection.intent: Remove templated funnel and AI-generated visual cues while preserving the approved sales sequence.
changes: replaced condensed all-caps typography with sentence-case IBM Plex Sans
removed decorative gradients, glows, badges, and repetitive card containers
replaced boxed process sections with one ruled chronological narrative
replaced pricing cards with a professional comparison table
limited the palette to navy, warm neutral, and one blue accent
